scope: Offline actual Studio diagnostics; no deployed product changes

protocol.memoryGc: Only final diagnostic point; never in timing
protocol.cacheLifetime: One synchronous query, read-only DOM snapshot; no retained geometry across gestures
protocol.feedbackMetric: Trusted pointerup capture -> awaitEval -> double requestAnimationFrame, excludes pre-dispatch queue, OS input and compositor presentation
protocol.sampling: Detailed stage timers / CPU / traces separate from timing; common lightweight counters remain in all three timing paths
protocol.memoryMetric: App-owned renderer RSS sum, not physical footprint; all attached unique V8 isolate heaps; WASM logical linear-memory capacity reported separately

decisions.wasm: Do not introduce: no incremental interaction benefit versus cached JS, no demonstrated memory saving
decisions.jsReadCache: Interaction benefit for GP; no product changes in this experiment. Further JS work should target paddingBox/ancestor-derived geometry and validate memory peaks
decisions.memory: No demonstrated stable saving; retained heap similar. Natural RSS peaks are noisy; WASM GP peaks higher in these two runs

kernel.implementation: Scalar Rust f64 batch predicates; no SIMD, workers or GPU

excludedRuns: Initial static-origin / alias / duplicate-entry pilots; not used
An obsolete functional pilot was stopped before qualification; not used
First profile round has valid stage counters/timeline but no standalone CPU profile; CPU attribution uses corrected round 2 only
